status: Integrated alpha32 production gate qualified through actual Android native account provider; physical phone delivery separate
purpose: Replace ordinary notification and manual Speak offline TTS primary rendering with existing ChatGPT-authenticated native Codex speech, independent of full voice mode.
implementation: PocketSpeech retains queue/MediaSession/MediaPlayer/captions/focus/background ownership; only chunk rendering changes.

New NativeSpeechRenderer negotiates bundled native WebRTC audio using synthetic silent input track, no microphone permission or coordinator turn. Captures remote bytes and closes render connection after each chunk.
Separate voice/speech purpose lanes are owned by the same authenticated device; speech cannot begin/commit task input. Starting a speech chunk never replaces controller audio.

Cancellable HTTP negotiation/speak/stop; cancellation destroys owned WebView and stops known exact connection. A negotiation cancelled before its id arrives can leave an orphan until the existing90-second server lease expires.

Provider-versioned render/cache identities prevent silent reuse of old offline audio. Existing offline cursor resets on first rerender because timings differ; native-rendered chunk files retain exact pause/seek cursor.

Italian rendering no longer requires an installed offline Italian voice. No offline fallback exposed; unavailable native provider leaves item paused and directly resumable/clearable. No paid API switch.

Playback-only capture binds observed native turn.created/done id, requires assistant role and complete expected transcript normalized for punctuation/case/NFKC, verifies tail timestamps, then drains RTP before recorder completion. Quiet alone cannot complete audio. Legacy full-voice defaults unchanged.
MediaPlayer rejects a cached container by deleting that current chunk file before saving Retry state, so retry renders fresh native audio instead of reusing an invalid blob forever.

checks.android: Both maintained signed builds and lint variants pass; each162 tests/36 suites with zero failures.
checks.provider: Exact corrected production gate passed through Android foreground and cold background/screen-off on public optimized APK; full authored assistant transcript and matching native turn required. No microphone permission or controller task.
checks.production: Root owns release and scoped bridge restart; no stock session restart.

limitations: Native Codex audio remains experimental and depends on account/CLI compatibility; exact grant/account debit not measured.
Native assistant turn id, role, complete normalized transcript and tail timestamps verified. Spoken number expansion may fail visibly rather than accepting incomplete content.
Buffered full chunk delays first speech by provider generation plus silence tail and negotiation each chunk.
No physical lockscreen/Bluetooth/readability or pronunciation quality claim.

scenarios: Local WebRTC peer supplies known recorded speech; normal notification and manual Speak do not request RECORD_AUDIO or start coordinator/voice service.
Long saved queue, pause/seek/resume/process recreation preserve provider-cache identity and caption chunk; old offline rendering invalidates safely.
Cancel/profile change/clear during negotiation and late audio do not cache or play wrong profile; disconnected native leaves saved item with retry/clear.
Run speech renderer alongside active voice to verify separate ids and no interruption, then reverse start/stop ordering.
Background/screen-off actual MediaRecorder capture and player delivery; secure keyguard privacy separately.
No paid key configuration/read/request. Host native ChatGPT gate observed; one short synthetic English read, one Italian phrase and one600-character multiple-sentence chunk.
Verify entire supplied passage including final sentinel is audible and transcribed/timestamped, not only nonempty audio bytes.
One manual Speak and one followed notification outside voice mode with Tailscale connected; preserve device drafts/tasks and avoid unsolicited microphone capture.
Observe long internal pause/chunk boundary and retry, actual chunk duration/latency; do not pronounce perfect provider verbatim compliance.
Bound connection stop/idle lease and exact owner cross-lane behavior; report actual billing evidence only if observed.

protocolEvidence: Observed native WebRTC turn.created/done structure replaces initial incorrect response.done assumption. Local raw realtime schema is untyped; actual role value and production gate must be asserted by final candidate smoke. No arbitrary sentinels appended to real content.
